_about: Sun & Moon-era English theme decks, sm1 Sun & Moon through sm12 Cosmic Eclipse: 25 decks (3 for sm1, 2 for each of sm2-sm12), written 2026-11-26. Lists: Bulbapedia deck pages (MediaWiki API wikitext, 'Deck list' tables) and TCGsync (tcgosaurus.tcgsync.com product pages, 'Deck List:' / 'Decklist:'); all 25 agree card-for-card by name and count (only differences: some TCGsync pages show the Cracked Ice showcase as its own '(Cracked Ice Holo)' line, and Bulbapedia writes 'Nidoran♀' where the site spells 'Nidoran ♀'). Release dates from Bulbapedia's deck infobox (single source; they are the deck release dates, e.g. Forest Shadow/Roaring Heat/Bright Tide 2017-01-20, two weeks before the set). Card ids resolved by set + number in data/<set>.json; cards from other sets keep their own set ids (sm1/sm2/sm3/sm4/sm5/sm6/sm7/sm8/sm9/sm10/sm11/sm12/sm75 as listed). Basic Energy: no source names the print; energy print assumed from release date: Sun & Moon 2017 (energy-<type>-sm17) for sm1-sm8, Sun & Moon 2019 (energy-<type>-sm19) for sm9 Team Up (Feb 2019) onward, same split as the site's ETB data (sun-moon.json etb.print) and Bulbapedia's note that Team Up has its own Energy print. No deck holds Fairy Energy (Sun & Moon decks are Grass/Fire/Water/Lightning/Psychic/Fighting/Darkness/Metal only), so no id-null Fairy row was needed. TCGplayer: sealed deck in the set's own group (checked on tcgcsv); showcase Cracked Ice print in group 1840 'Deck Exclusives' (names are like 'Decidueye - 011/149 (Cracked Ice Holo)' or only '(SM Forbidden Light)' with foilOnly true for several; those are still the deck's Cracked Ice print). Extra field 'exclusivePrints' lists other deck-only non-holo prints found in group 1840 (from Bulbapedia trivia). marketPrice is TCGplayer market via tcgcsv, null where TCGplayer has none (9 decks). Left out: Shining Legends (sm35), Dragon Majesty (sm75), Hidden Fates (sm115) and Detective Pikachu (det1) had no theme decks (TCGplayer groups hold only ETBs, tins, collections, Case Files). Already on the site and skipped: smp Pikachu & Zekrom-GX League Battle Deck, Let's Play Eevee theme deck, Alolan Sandslash/Ninetales Trainer Kit. Also not covered: Battle Arena / Legendary Battle Decks (not theme decks).

decks.name: Forest Shadow
decks.showcasePrint: Cracked Ice holofoil print, exclusive to this theme deck (Bulbapedia: 'The Cracked Ice Holofoil version of Decidueye is exclusive to this deck'); not the pack print.
decks.tcgplayerName: Sun & Moon Base Set Theme Deck - "Forest Shadow" [Decidueye]
decks.extras: 60-card deck, damage counters, custom coin (Bulbapedia coin art: SUM Green Rowlet Coin.png), rulesheet, card list, deckbox, two-player mat, TCG Online code card (TCGplayer sells it separately: 'Code Card - "Forest Shadow" Theme Deck'). No booster pack.

sources.quote: Bulbapedia deck list, 60 cards; release January 20, 2017; pack contents line; trivia on Cracked Ice / non-holo exclusives
TCGsync (tcgosaurus) product page 'Deck List': same cards and counts as Bulbapedia (Cracked Ice copy shown as a separate '(Cracked Ice Holo)' line on some pages)

decks.notes: Basic Energy: no source names the print; energy print assumed from release date (2017-01-20): Sun & Moon 2017 print (ids energy-<type>-sm17) for sm1-sm8 decks, Sun & Moon 2019 print (sm19) from Team Up (Feb 2019) on, matching the site's ETB convention (scripts/box-research/sun-moon.json etb.print). Fairy Energy does not occur: Sun & Moon decks hold no Fairy. Decidueye is 2 copies per Bulbapedia: 1 Cracked Ice Holo (deck exclusive, Decidueye - 011/149 (Cracked Ice Holo), TCGplayer 131299 in Deck Exclusives group 1840) + 1 listed as plain 'Rare'; both are sm1-11. Other deck-only prints (group 1840): Shiinotic sm1-17 -> 131300 Shiinotic - 17/149 (SM Base Set); Kangaskhan sm1-99 -> 131301 Kangaskhan - 99/149 (SM Base Set). The site's own card for these ids may be holo where the deck copy is non-holo. Bulbapedia trivia: The Cracked Ice Holofoil version of Decidueye is exclusive to this deck. | The Non Holofoil versions of Shiinotic and Kangaskhan are exclusive to this deck.
